card.line: Kiriath-sepher, later called Debir, was a city in Judah's land that Othniel captured, winning Caleb's daughter Acsah as his wife.

moments.title: Caleb's challenge
moments.text: Caleb marched against the people of Debir, which was once called Kiriath-sepher. He promised his daughter Acsah in marriage to the man who struck down the city and captured it.

moments.title: Othniel captures the city
moments.text: Othniel, son of Caleb's brother Kenaz, captured the city. Caleb gave him his daughter Acsah to be his wife.

moments.title: Judah marches on Debir
moments.text: The men of Judah marched against the people of Debir, formerly Kiriath-sepher. Caleb offered Acsah to the one who captured it, and Othniel took the city and received her.
